status_summary: ODNI's August 2025 reorganization fact sheet kept NCTC and said it is building capability for two-way information sharing between federal, state and local law enforcement, an integration function. On 2025-10-23 the DNI announced an NCTC Interagency Fusion Cell to improve two-way sharing between the IC and law enforcement in support of the Homeland Security Task Force, whose targets include terrorist organizations, cartels and gangs. No public step cutting NCTC analysis that duplicates FBI or CIA work was found, and no output of the fusion cell has been published. Division F of Public Law 119-60 (signed 2025-12-18) has no NCTC section; bills that would rename and reform the center (S. 2202) or limit its domestic activities to international terrorism (S. 4615, Sec. 305, reported 2026-05-20) are not enacted.

title: Focus NCTC on integrative tasks and stop analysis duplicating FBI and CIA
uncertainties: Stage is proposed: the fusion cell and law-enforcement sharing are integrative, as the text asks, but they are announced capabilities with no published output, and nothing shows duplicative analysis being cut; the match is parallel because the new work extends NCTC into counternarcotics and law-enforcement support rather than narrowing it. The fusion cell announcement is known from a trade outlet (ExecutiveGov, 2025-10-27); the ODNI press release it links redirected to the ODNI newsroom and was not read. The chapter text calls the center by a different name once; this record follows the recommendation's subject, NCTC. Related ODNI downsizing is covered in c07-01, which is a cross-reference, not a duplicate, since c07-01 does not address the NCTC passage on page 219.
